query: What are the states of matter and phase transitions?
title: States of Matter and Phase Transitions

scenes.title: The Kinetic Nature of Matter
scenes.narration: Matter exists in three primary physical states: solid, liquid, and gas, governed by molecular kinetic energy.
scenes.key_takeaway: Matter exists as solid, liquid, or gas depending on molecular kinetic energy.

scenes.title: Solid Lattice to Fluid Liquid
scenes.narration: In solids, particles vibrate in rigid lattices; adding thermal energy melts them into fluid liquids.
scenes.key_takeaway: Adding heat breaks rigid crystal bonds, transitioning solids to liquids.

scenes.title: Vaporization to High-Velocity Gas
scenes.narration: Further heating vaporizes liquid into high-speed gas particles that move freely and collide chaotically.
scenes.key_takeaway: Vaporization frees molecules into high-speed, chaotic gas collisions.

scenes.title: Phase Equilibrium and Conservation
scenes.narration: Throughout every phase transition, chemical identity is conserved as temperature alters only intermolecular kinetic organization.
scenes.key_takeaway: Phase changes alter physical organization while chemical identity remains conserved.
